mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT region.region_id as area_id, region.region_name as area_name, f.up_region_id as bay_id, f.up_region_name as bay_name, a.instance_id AS device_id, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name) END) AS device_name, b.custom_id as component_id, m.dict_note as component_name, f.device_id AS main_device_id, f.device_name as main_device_name, f.preset_id AS device_preset_id, f.camera_id AS device_camera_id, j.up_dict as device_type, f.real_code, f.alias_name, f.model_id, g.device_model, g.pms_type, g.pms_id, g.device_vendor, g.used_time, g.maintenance_count, g.responsible_person, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.ip, g.port, g.voltage_level, g.sequence_point, g.address, case b.meter_type when 411 then '1' when 412 then '2' when 413 then '3' when 414 then '4' when 415 then '5' when 416 then '6' when 417 then '7' when 418 then '8' when 419 then '9' end as meter_type, b.mete_type, o.algorithm_id, (b.appearance_type - 419) as appearance_type, b.device_mete_id AS device_mete_id, b.device_point_id, b.inspection_type, b.mete_kind, b.position_type, b.analyse_type, b.is_ai, b.is_judge, b.unit, b.alarm_note, b.alarm_type, b.up_effect, b.down_effect, b.state_zero, b.state_one, b.alarm_state, b.alarm_level, b.high_limit1, b.high_limit2, b.high_limit3, b.high_limit4, b.low_limit1, b.low_limit2, b.low_limit3, b.low_limit4, b.alarm_delay, b.alarm_cnt, b.threshold_abs, b.threshold_per, b.redundant_type, "" as save_type_list, k.dict_note as recognition_type_list, "" as phase, "" as device_info, "" as data_type, "" as lower_value, "" as upper_value, "" as video_pos, a.cruise_type, c.inspection_id AS inspection_id, d.preset_id AS preset_id, d.preset_num, d.preset_type, CONCAT('/', d.preset_id,'/' ,d.preset_id,'.jpg') AS preset_img, REPLACE(d.preset_img, (SELECT content FROM t_sys_param WHERE param_code = 'presetRealImgPath') ,(SELECT content FROM t_sys_param WHERE param_code = 'presetImgPath')) AS local_path, robot.robot_code, robot.robot_num, d.camera_id AS camera_id, i.voice_device_id AS voice_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_algorithm_mete o ON o.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON a.cruise_id = c.inspection_id left join t_robot_info robot on c.robot_id = robot.robot_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON a.cruise_id = d.preset_id left join t_std_device f on a.device_id = f.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device_attr g ON g.device_id= f.device_id left join t_std_region re on f.up_region_id = re.region_id left join t_std_region region on re.up_region_id = region.region_id left join t_dict_business j on f.device_type = j.dict_code left join t_dict_business k on a.cruise_type = k.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business m ON b.custom_id = m.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_voice_device i ON i.voice_device_id = a.cruise_id

select a.robot_name as patroldevice_name, a.robot_code as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, a.building_user as use_unit, a.robot_source as device_source, DATE_FORMAT(a.commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as production_date, a.appearance_number as production_code, if(b.dict_code = 399, 0, 1) as istransport, '' as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.light_ip is null AND a.lnferad_IP is null THEN '' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) > 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) = 0 THEN '2' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) = 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) AND locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) THEN '3' else '' end) as video_mode, a.address as place, (CASE WHEN a.robot_position = 155 THEN '2' WHEN a.robot_position = 156 THEN '1' WHEN a.robot_position = 399 THEN '3' end) as type, a.remarks as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.robot_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code where a.robot_type is not null

select a.robot_name as patroldevice_name, a.robot_code as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, a.building_user as use_unit, a.robot_source as device_source, DATE_FORMAT(a.commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as production_date, a.appearance_number as production_code, if(b.dict_code = 399, 0, 1) as istransport, '' as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.light_ip is null AND a.lnferad_IP is null THEN '' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) > 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) = 0 THEN '2' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) = 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) AND locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) THEN '3' else '' end) as video_mode, a.address as place, (CASE WHEN a.drone_position = 674 THEN '13' end) as type, '' as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.drone_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code where a.drone_type is not null

select a.voice_device_name as patroldevice_name, a.voice_code as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, '亿嘉和' as use_unit, '亿嘉和' as device_source, '' as production_date, '' as production_code, '' as istransport, '' as use_mode, '' as video_mode, '' as place, '14' as type, '' as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code from t_voice_device a left join t_dict_business b on a.voice_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.voice_factory = c.dict_code

select a.camera_name as patroldevice_name, a.camera_id as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, a.unit as use_unit, c.dict_note as device_source, DATE_FORMAT(a.commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as production_date, '' as production_code, '' as istransport, if(a.is_control = 1, '11', '10') as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.camera_type = 205 THEN '1' WHEN a.camera_type = 206 THEN '2' end) as video_mode, a.address as place, '10' as type, '' as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code from t_camera_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.camera_model = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.vendor_id = c.dict_code

SELECT b.up_dict as type, a.task_id as task_code, a.task_name, a.task_level as priority, "3" as device_level, -- IFNULL(a.date_type, "") as time, "" as cycle_month, "" as cycle_week, "" as cycle_execute_time, "" as cycle_start_time, "" as cycle_end_time, "" as interval_number, "" as interval_type, "" as interval_execute_time, "" as interval_start_time, "" as interval_end_time, "" as invalid_start_time, "" as invalid_end_time, '0' isenable, u.user_name as creator, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as fixed_start_time, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time from t_cruise_task a left join sys_user u on a.create_user_id = u.user_id left join t_dict_business b on a.type = b.dict_code and b.col_name="plan_type" left join t_cruise_result c on a.task_id = c.task_id

select maintenance_id, maintenance_name, IF(device_level=3,instance_ids,device_ids) AS device_ids, is_valid , DATE_FORMAT(maintenance_start, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as maintenance_start, DATE_FORMAT(maintenance_stop, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as maintenance_stop, coordinate_pixel, device_level from t_device_maintenance

select count(1) as totalNum, (select count(1) from u_patrol_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and task_state = 240) as validNum from u_patrol_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and task_state in (240,242,243,244)

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, count(t.deal_type) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, sum(IF(detail.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1)) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result result LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result detail ON detail.task_id = result.task_id WHERE result.execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result result LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result detail ON result.task_id = detail.task_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select a.*, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END ) AS instanceName, b.analyse_type, b.is_ai, b.is_judge, f.device_name, g.real_code, c.robot_id, IFNULL(c.inspection_name,d.preset_name) as cruiseName FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON a.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON a.cruise_id = d.preset_id left join (select distinct device_id,device_name from t_std_device) f on a.device_id = f.device_id left join t_std_device_attr g on f.device_id = g.device_id where b.device_point_id in
#{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
